column3: DA 第 7 装甲集团军战役信息

column2: Extract directly into the C:\Panzer2\SCENARIO directory.  Two campaigns will appear below the SSI provided ones.  These campaigns are: The 7 PanzerArmee and The 7 PanzerArmee Defends the Reich.  It uses my CNEfile provided, it should be used on a Panzer2.dat filed treated with Lasse Jensen's icon update file.  The campaign army is equivalent to my campaign army during play-testing.
column3: 直接解压到 C:\Panzer2\SCENARIO 目录。在 SSI 提供的战役下方会出现两个战役。这两个战役是：The 7 PanzerArmee 和 The 7 PanzerArmee Defends the Reich。它使用我提供的 CNEfile，应当用在经 Lasse Jensen 图标更新文件处理过的 Panzer2.dat 文件上。战役军队与我测试时的战役军队相当。

column2: The campaign, “The Gallantry of the 7th PanzerArmee” has always impressed me as one of the best.  Actually it was the first custom-made campaign I played and it incited me to become a campaign designer.  It is almost universally agreed that the first 13 scenarios are some of the best designed for a campaign.  Unfortunately there is also the impression that the end scenarios of the campaign do not measure up to the previous ones.  I decided to do something about it.  I replaced the last seven scenarios of the campaign by seven completely new ones.  I grouped the seven last originals into a losing path similar to the “Defending the Reich campaign”.  I added a modified version of one of my own scenarios to provide an end to this track.  I also added three of my own scenarios to the losing track and I created a new campaign, “The 7th PanzerArmee Defends the Reich”.  This campaign can be played independently using an extra provided camp file.
column3: 战役《第 7 装甲集团军的英勇(The Gallantry of the 7th PanzerArmee)》一直是我印象中最好的战役之一。实际上它是我玩的第一个自制战役，也是它促使我成为战役设计者。几乎所有人都认同，前 13 个场景是专为战役设计的最出色的一批。可惜也有一种印象，认为战役末尾的场景不如之前的。我决定对此做点什么。我用七个全新的场景替换了战役的最后七个场景。我把最后七个原版场景编成了一条失败线，类似《Defending the Reich campaign》。我加入了自己一个场景的修改版，为这条线提供结局。我还把自己三个场景加入失败线，并创建了一个新战役《第 7 装甲集团军保卫帝国(The 7th PanzerArmee Defends the Reich)》。这个战役可以用额外提供的一个 camp 文件独立游玩。
通往柏林之路(The Road to Berlin)（10d）

column2: The losing scenarios for the first 13 main campaign scenarios are similar to the actual scenarios, but slightly easier.  The losing scenarios after the 14th are the ones marked * in the second campaign.  The Kalastch scenario in the main campaign losing path is A714v.  This scenario is different from the first in the campaign The 7 PanzerArmee Defends the Reich.

column2: There is a bug in the program affecting the last scenario in the Defending the Reich campaign, Summer Storm.  Before the Soviet turn you will get a message that says, debug error, too many units for player 1.  Disregard the message by pushing enter.  Do it several times if you need.  There are no more than 95 units for the Soviets, but the program miscounts.  After a couple of turns it will not appear anymore and it does not affect play.
column3: 程序里有一个错误，影响 Defending the Reich 战役的最后一个场景《Summer Storm》。在苏军回合之前，你会收到一条消息：debug error, too many units for player 1。按回车忽略这条消息。如果需要就多按几次。苏军单位不超过 95 个，但程序数错了。几个回合之后它就不再出现，也不影响游玩。

column2: If you are currently playing any previous release of "7.Panzerarmee", it's OK to install and overwrite the files. Once you finish your scenario, the new campaign will take over.

column2: In the Normandy scenario, DO NOT take the Allied ownership hex, which is the airfield, on the south end of the map until you get your large allotment of prestige points at the 16th turn. Furthermore, do not allow the U.S. to take their victory hex or the scenario will end, so concentrate on defending that hex. On the 15th and 16th turns, you will receive reinforcements that will originate from the south, close to the Allied airfield. They serve two purposes; the first is that you can use them to take the airfield to achieve your brilliant victory, and the second is that they simulate the assistance provided to you by neighboring units. As the 16th turn approaches, watch your prestige points. Once your prestige points exceed 5500, you are free to take the Allied hex, which will be necessary to achieve a brilliant victory. No more prestige will be given.
column3: 在诺曼底(Normandy)场景中，在你于第 16 回合拿到那一大笔威望点数之前，不要占领地图南端的盟军所属格，也就是机场。此外，不要让美军占领他们的胜利格，否则场景就会结束，所以要集中力量防守那个格。在第 15 和第 16 回合，你会收到补充兵员，他们从南方、靠近盟军机场的位置出现。他们有两个用途：第一，你可以用他们占领机场，以达成辉煌胜利；第二，他们模拟邻近单位对你的援助。第 16 回合临近时，留意你的威望点数。一旦你的威望点数超过 5500，你就可以自由占领盟军的格，这是达成辉煌胜利所必需的。不会再给更多威望了。

column2: In this fictional story, Hitler reacts from the fear that his nation's economic sovereignty is threatened by his neighbors. Skirmishes within his border causes him to use force. With the success of the Commander of 7.Panzerarmee, he does not make the mistakes that he is known for. He overruns Moscow, and the disaster at Stalingrad does not happen. Unfortunately, his men and resources get depleted. The Allies see that the Germans are almost invincible, especially with their superior war equipment. With the capture of General Patton, and their  ignorance of Germany's depleting resources, they decide to seek a peaceful resolution. Affected by the lack of supplies, Germany is also forced to seek an end to the war. The two sides eventually come to an agreement. (Details of the agreement, I believe, are not important.)
column3: 在这个虚构的故事里，希特勒出于对本国经济主权受邻国威胁的恐惧而做出反应。边境内的冲突使他动用武力。由于 7.Panzerarmee 指挥官的成功，他没有犯下那些为人熟知的错误。他击溃了莫斯科，斯大林格勒的灾难也没有发生。不幸的是，他的人员和资源耗尽了。盟军看到德国人几乎不可战胜，尤其是凭借他们优越的战争装备。随着巴顿将军被俘，加上他们对德国资源枯竭一无所知，他们决定寻求和平解决。受补给匮乏影响，德国也被迫寻求结束战争。双方最终达成协议。（协议的细节，我认为并不重要。）

column2: If the you, the player, lose a key battle, the stress of war will affect Hitler, and he loses his ability to use sound judgement. The war will end with the humiliation of Hitler and Germany.
column3: 如果你，也就是玩家，输掉一场关键战斗，战争的压力就会影响希特勒，他会失去做出正确判断的能力。战争将以希特勒和德国的屈辱告终。

column2: This file updates "a7panze2.zip" and "a7panzer.zip". Changes made to "a7panze2.zip" are minor, but nevertheless, here they are:
column3: 这个文件更新 "a7panze2.zip" 和 "a7panzer.zip"。对 "a7panze2.zip" 的改动不大，不过还是列在这里：

column2: 1)\tSome scenarios did not have the units' experience levels set to match their experience bars. Now, all scenarios have their experience levels set properly. Setting them allows non-core and enemy units an equal chance to acquire leaders during battle.
column3: 1)\t有些场景没有把单位的经验等级设置得与其经验条相符。现在所有场景的经验等级都设置正确了。这样设置后，非核心单位和敌方单位在战斗中也有同等机会获得指挥官。

column2: 2)\tI consolidated and refined the readme files of the previous releases of "7.Panzerarmee".
column3: 2)\t我整合并改进了《7.Panzerarmee》此前各版本的说明文件。

column2: 3)\tI modified the Normandy scenario again. This time I'm a bit more content with it.
column3: 3)\t我再次修改了诺曼底场景。这一次我对它稍微满意一些。

column2: 4)\tI added the "a7other" folder, which contains the "Camp7.cam" file that I use to play the campaign. This will take you through the main upper-level scenarios only. If you believe that you're an expert player, use this file. Take the "Camp7.cam" file out of its folder and put it into the "Scenario" folder. Then, you'll want to take the "Camp7d.cam" file out of the "Scenario" folder and put it into the "a7other" folder.
column3: 4)\t我添加了 "a7other" 文件夹，里面有我游玩这个战役所用的 "Camp7.cam" 文件。它会只带你走主线的高层场景。如果你认为自己是高手玩家，就用这个文件。把 "Camp7.cam" 文件从它的文件夹里取出来，放进 "Scenario" 文件夹。然后，你要把 "Camp7d.cam" 文件从 "Scenario" 文件夹里取出来，放进 "a7other" 文件夹。

column2: 5)\tI increased the turns required for a brilliant victory in the Volturno scenario.
column3: 5)\t我增加了沃尔图诺(Volturno)场景达成辉煌胜利所需的回合数。

column2: In reference to the supply hexes, especially in the latter scenarios, follow this procedure:
column3: 关于补给格，尤其是后期场景中的补给格，请按以下步骤操作：

column2: 1)\tinsert your units, then enter the scenario
column3: 1)\t插入你的单位，然后进入场景

column2: 2)\tspread your units out as far as they can go, click the deploy button
column3: 2)\t把你的单位尽量展开，点击部署按钮

column2: 3)\treinsert more of your units, and reenter the scenario
column3: 3)\t再插入更多单位，再进入场景

column3: 5)\t重复以上步骤，直到你想部署的所有单位都位于你想要的位置

column2: About the captured units, such as the Soviet tanks, that are sometimes provided to you, if you capture hexes with them, the flag of the ownership hexes will turn into the Soviet flag or will stay the Soviet flag. This is fine. You'll still get your prestige points, and you can still win the scenario doing this. In Dinant, you'll have Volksturns possessing American and Soviet halftracks. If you capture ownership hexes with them, the flags will turn into a either U.S. flag or Soviet flag depending upon which halftrack you capture it with. Again, you'll still get your prestige points. Do not waste your time recapturing ownership hexes. You will not gain additional prestige points.
column3: 关于有时提供给你的缴获单位，比如苏联坦克，如果你用它们占领格，所属格的旗帜会变成苏联旗，或者保持苏联旗。这没问题。你仍然会拿到威望点数，这样做也仍然能赢得场景。在迪南(Dinant)，你会有人民冲锋队(Volksturn)使用美制和苏制半履带车。如果你用它们占领所属格，旗帜会变成美国旗或苏联旗，取决于你是用哪种半履带车占领的。同样，你仍然会拿到威望点数。不要浪费时间反复夺回所属格。你不会得到额外的威望点数。

column2: In the Normandy scenario, if set your unit(s) on the hex adjacent to the Allied ownership hex, the AI will see your unit(s), so you should not have any of your units occupying those hexes unless you want them seen.
column3: 在诺曼底场景中，如果你把单位放在与盟军所属格相邻的格上，AI 就会看到你的单位，所以除非你想让它们被发现，否则不要让任何单位占据那些格。

column2: In the Pont-a-Mousson scenario, there is no special procedure for capturing General Patton. Play the scenario like you would normally do; wipe out General Patton if you have to. Through some miracle, he'll emerge from the rubble alive.
column3: 在蓬塔穆松(Pont-a-Mousson)场景中，俘获巴顿将军没有特别的做法。照常游玩这个场景；必要时就消灭巴顿将军。出于某种奇迹，他会从废墟中活着出来。

column2: If you would like to use an equipment file other than the standard PG II files, I'd just like to caution you. Fred reported that in using Waffenkammer equipment files, he encountered a "vast number of 7-range arty pieces". In the standard PG II files, the longest range for a non-marksman Soviet artillery unit is 4, and I did not create too many marksman Soviet artillery units. In creating the campaign, I adjusted the strength levels and positioned the artillery units according to the values present in the standard PG II files, which is what I used. I never intended to have opposing units stronger than what is on the standard. If I would have used the Waffenkammer files, I would have strengthened units and postioned artillery units differently.
column3: 如果你想使用标准 PG II 文件以外的装备文件，我只想提醒你一下。Fred 报告说，使用 Waffenkammer 装备文件时，他遇到了「大量射程为 7 的火炮单位」。在标准 PG II 文件中，非神射手的苏联炮兵单位最大射程是 4，而我没有制作太多神射手的苏联炮兵单位。制作这个战役时，我是按照标准 PG II 文件中的数值来调整兵力等级和布置炮兵单位的，我用的是标准文件。我从未打算让敌方单位比标准中的更强。如果我用了 Waffenkammer 文件，我会以不同的方式加强单位和布置炮兵单位。

column2: This is the best campaign I can come up with that combines history with playability. In my opinion, the biggest obstacle preventing completely historical campaigns from ever being created is the individual player's freedom to choose the composition of his army. General Guderian had little choice in which tanks and troops he can have, but the Panzer General II player can have anything he can buy - even if it just came out of the assembly line.
column3: 这是我能想出的兼顾历史与可玩性的最好战役。在我看来，完全历史化的战役之所以始终无法产生，最大的障碍在于每位玩家可以自由选择自己军队的组成。古德里安将军几乎无从选择他能拥有哪些坦克和部队，但 Panzer General II 的玩家可以拥有他买得起的一切——哪怕它刚下生产线。

column2: There are several ways in which I attempted at making each individual scenario close to being historic:
column3: 我曾尝试用几种办法让每个场景都接近历史：

column2: 1) \tTo the best of my knowledge, I presented real people (Generals Heidrich, Manteuffel, Patton, Strauss, von Paulus, the Generalissimo of the Red Army, Colonel Talvela, the Fuhrer, and Mussolini) and real locations in the story.
column3: 1) \t据我所知，我在故事中呈现了真实人物（Heidrich、Manteuffel、Patton、Strauss、von Paulus 诸位将军，红军大元帅，Talvela 上校，元首，以及 Mussolini）和真实地点。

column2: 2) \tI inserted maps having the terrain features that are close to what I imagine would be found in those locations.
column3: 2) \t我插入的地图具有的地形特征接近我想象中那些地点会有的样子。

column2: 3) \tI inserted the approximate date of each battle.
column3: 3) \t我插入了每场战斗的大致日期。

column2: 4)\tI restricted the number of deployment hexes and didn't provide supply hexes on some scenarios to prevent players from inserting units that I do not think belong in the scenario.
column3: 4)\t我限制了部署格的数量，并在某些场景中不提供补给格，以防玩家插入我认为不属于该场景的单位。

column2: 5)\tAfter researching several sources, which are mentioned at the Works Cited section, and rewording their passages, I inserted propaganda that the German people and troops were exposed to, which thus motivated them to fight.
column3: 5)\t在研究了若干资料（列在引用文献一节）并改写其中的段落之后，我插入了德国人民和部队当时接触到的宣传内容，这些内容激励他们作战。

column2: My research and attempt at creating a decent story behind the campaign were the hardest and most time consuming in the project - even harder than creating good scenarios. If I didn't have anything good or relevant to say in the text files, I just left them off.
column3: 我的资料研究以及为战役编写一个像样故事的努力，是这个项目中最艰难、最耗时的部分——甚至比制作好场景还难。如果我在文本文件里没有好东西或相关内容可说，我就干脆不写。

column2: I designed this campaign to allow players with the widest varying skill levels possible. I did this by providing two variants of the same scenario. One is an upper level scenario and the other is a lower level scenario. A player starts at the upper level and will stay there if he consistently achieves a brilliant victory. If at any time, the player finishes with less than a brilliant victory, he will drop to the lower level. The way he can get back to the upper level is through attaining a brilliant victory. An average player can repeatedly get bumped between the upper level and the lower level. The difference between an upper level and a lower level v-designated scenario is that the lower level scenario is easier than its upper level counterpart. The opposition force is lower in strength and in number. However, since the lower level is suppose to be easier, I lowered the turns required for a brilliant victory. If you lose units here and there, even elite units, don't get too concerned; I designed each subsequent scenario to allow for this. Furthermore, the v-designated scenario is present if you fall too much.
column3: 我设计这个战役，是为了尽可能容纳技术水平差异最大的玩家。做法是为同一个场景提供两个变体。一个是高层场景，另一个是低层场景。玩家从高层开始，只要持续达成辉煌胜利就会留在那里。任何时候，如果玩家以低于辉煌胜利的成绩结束，就会掉到低层。他回到高层的办法就是达成一次辉煌胜利。普通玩家可能会在高层和低层之间反复来回。高层与低层 v 标记场景的区别在于，低层场景比对应的高层场景更容易。敌方兵力在强度和数量上都更低。不过，既然低层本来就应该更容易，我降低了达成辉煌胜利所需的回合数。如果你这里那里损失了单位，哪怕是精锐单位，也不用太担心；我设计后续每个场景时都考虑到了这一点。此外，如果你下滑太多，就会出现 v 标记的场景。

column2: My decision to use standard Panzer General II equipment files allows the most possible players to play my campaign. They can always use other equipment files of their choice as long as they are compatible. During my design, I acquired captured equipment by changing the appropriate numbers with Lasse's Scenario Editor. I especially got a kick out of changing the trucks of infantry and artillery units. For instance, there is a captured U.S. 8 inch artillery piece that is towed by a French truck, and the Fallschirmjagers and other infantry are running around with British, American, French, Soviet, and Italian troop carriers.
column3: 我决定使用标准的 Panzer General II 装备文件，是为了让尽可能多的玩家能游玩我的战役。他们只要愿意，随时可以使用其他自己喜欢的装备文件，只要兼容就行。设计期间，我用 Lasse 的场景编辑器修改相应的数字，从而获得缴获装备。我特别得意于更换步兵和炮兵单位的卡车。比如，有一门缴获的美制 8 英寸火炮由一辆法国卡车牵引，而伞兵和其他步兵则坐着英国、美国、法国、苏联和意大利的运兵车到处跑。

column2: In the last three scenarios, setting the AI's flags to France has a nice effect, especially on the Pont-a-Mousson and Dinant scenarios. Those ownership hexes (the non-victory hexes) that have a U.S. flag on it serve as markers of hexes that can be avoided. They will only turn into a U.S. flag if the U.S. loses the hex and recaptures it.
column3: 在最后三个场景中，把 AI 的旗帜设为法国会产生不错的效果，尤其是在蓬塔穆松和迪南场景中。那些挂美国旗的所属格（非胜利格）可以当作应避开格的标记。只有当美军丢掉该格又重新夺回时，它才会变成美国旗。

column2: (please read only after you play the campaign)

Just so you're familiar with army composition variations, you should look at Kovi's "tank-recon-air defense concept", and the "no-air force concept". I think they're very interesting. However, in this campaign, I would not go without artillery units. I designed this campaign, almost to the point of going overboard, so you would have to use artillery units. Only Kovi might be able to pull off a no-artillery army. I can see a player being able to do without an air force, but the player would not experience the air war that I designed. It's like me taking a lot of time to create a gourmet meal, then seeing someone put hot sauce on it; that just ruins my intentions.
column3: 为了让你熟悉军队编成的各种变化，你应该看看 Kovi 的「坦克-侦察-对空防御构想」和「无空军构想」。我觉得它们非常有意思。不过，在这个战役里，我不会不用炮兵单位。我设计这个战役时几乎到了过分的程度，就是要让你必须使用炮兵单位。也许只有 Kovi 能玩得转无炮兵的军队。我看得出玩家可以不用空军，但那样玩家就体验不到我设计的空战了。这就像我花很多时间做了一道美食，然后看到有人往上面浇辣酱；那完全毁了我的用意。

column2: In order to make the game as fair as possible, I tried to put myself in the position of the unsuspecting player. To reach all objectives in the shortest time possible, I would split my armies evenly, and then, as a campaign maker, I would split the opposition forces evenly because putting opposition forces heavily in one sector can really screw up a good portion of a player's units. In my design, if the player does run into heavy opposition in one particular sector, the player can only blame the AI because the AI is the one doing all the redeploying. One time, I was playing Kharkov and three Soviet tanks showed up in my southwestern-most ownership hex when I was very close to getting my victory hexes. They didn't show up all at one time, but seeing three tanks in one area put some sweat on my forehead. Luckily the weather was decent, and with my bombers and fighters, I was able to reduce their strength enough so that my Fallschirmjagers were able to hold their position.
column3: 为了让游戏尽可能公平，我试着把自己放在毫无戒心的玩家的位置上。为了用最短时间达成所有目标，我会把自己的军队平均分兵；而作为战役制作者，我也会把敌方兵力平均分兵，因为把敌方兵力大量集中在一个地段，真的会毁掉玩家相当一部分单位。在我的设计中，如果玩家确实在某个特定地段遭遇强敌，那只能怪 AI，因为重新部署全是 AI 在做。有一次，我在打哈尔科夫(Kharkov)，就在我快要拿到胜利格的时候，三辆苏联坦克出现在我最西南的所属格里。它们不是同时出现的，但看到一个区域里冒出三辆坦克，还是让我额头冒汗。幸好天气不错，靠着我的轰炸机和战斗机，我把它们的兵力削弱到足够程度，我的伞兵才守住了阵地。

column2: There's another area where my design paid off. The main purpose of those infantry reinforcements is to keep rear areas secure because there are going to be some individual enemy units that sometimes make a run for their victory hex. I absolutely hate losing games this way. The Fallschirmjager reinforcement in the Tolvajarvi scenario, however, is meant to assist the isolated Finnish units across the lake.
column3: 还有一处设计收到了成效。那些步兵补充兵员的主要用途是保障后方安全，因为总会有一些零散的敌方单位有时会直奔他们的胜利格。我绝对讨厌以这种方式输掉游戏。不过，托尔瓦耶尔维(Tolvajarvi)场景中的伞兵补充兵员，是为了支援湖对岸被孤立的芬兰单位。

column2: I was not aware just how stupid the AI is until I created the Normandy scenario. From its original conception, I must have modified and play-tested the scenario a dozen times before I decided to add it to the campaign, and I varied my play-testing greatly. The AI was just not coming close to its victory hexes. I brought his victory hexes closer, then I removed one victory hex so that he can concentrate on only one. After I found the AI's bombers out ammunition, I gave him a land-based air field because he did not know to go to his aircraft carrier to resupply! After my release of "The Gallantry of 7.Panzerarmee", I again decided to bring the U.S.' victory hex closer. This time I'm finally happy with the results.
column3: 直到制作诺曼底场景时，我才意识到 AI 到底有多蠢。从最初的构想算起，在我决定把它加入战役之前，我肯定修改并测试了这个场景十几次，而且测试时变化很大。AI 就是靠近不了它的胜利格。我把它的胜利格拉近，然后又去掉一个胜利格，让它只专注一个。在我发现 AI 的轰炸机弹药耗尽之后，我给它配了一个陆上机场，因为它不知道要去航母上补给！在我发布《The Gallantry of 7.Panzerarmee》之后，我又决定把美军的胜利格拉得更近。这一次我终于对结果满意了。

column2: This campaign went longer than I wanted. The most difficult thing I found in making a long campaign is that it is difficult to estimate at what strength the player's forces might be at late in the campaign. I didn't want to make the opposition forces too weak, and I certainly didn't want to make them too strong. My decision to restrict deployment capabilities in the earlier scenarios turned out to be more important than I thought. They did a good job at keeping the player's unit strengths from becoming too excessive. Furthermore, it gave him the option of having either few units that are very powerful or having all of his units fairly even in strength by using one set of units in one scenario and the others in another scenario.
column3: 这个战役比我想要的更长。制作长期战役时我发现最难的一点是，很难估计玩家部队在战役后期会有多强。我不想让敌方兵力太弱，当然也不想让它们太强。我限制早期场景部署能力的决定，结果比我以为的更重要。它们在防止玩家单位兵力变得过度强大方面效果很好。此外，它还给玩家一个选择：要么拥有少数非常强大的单位，要么通过在一个场景使用一批单位、在另一个场景使用另一批单位，让所有单位兵力较为均衡。

column2: In creating this campaign, I formed the opinion that a campaign maker should not use the special abilities of his leaders during play-testing. I did not use my liberator(s) to capture hexes, I downgraded my marksmen artillery units so that they would have a maximum range of 5 hexes, I did not use my units with devastating fire to fire twice, etc. If I were to have used my leaders' attributes, I would've set the prestige points and brilliant victory turn requirements too low. A campaign maker should not assume that the players of his game are able to acquire the necessary leaders. When I play-tested my campaign from the beginning after I released "The Gallantry of 7.Panzerarmee", I did not acquire a single elite recon veteran. Is that unusual or what!
column3: 在制作这个战役的过程中，我形成了一种看法：战役制作者在测试时不应该使用自己指挥官的特殊能力。我没有用我的解放者单位去占领格，我把我神射手的炮兵单位降级，使它们的最大射程只有 5 格，我没有用具有毁灭性火力的单位开火两次，等等。如果我用了我指挥官的特质，我就会把威望点数和辉煌胜利的回合要求设得太低。战役制作者不应该假定自己游戏的玩家都能获得必要的指挥官。在我发布《The Gallantry of 7.Panzerarmee》之后从头测试我的战役时，我一个精锐侦察老兵都没获得。这算不算少见！
